title: 03. Embeddings & Vector DBs: Embedding Model Selection
summary: Selecting the right embedding model is a critical architectural decision that affects retrieval quality, cost, latency, and maintenance burden.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Selecting the right embedding model is a critical architectural decision that affects retrieval quality, cost, latency, and maintenance burden. The choice involves tradeoffs across multiple dimensions: API-based models (OpenAI, Cohere) offer convenience and top benchmark performance but create vendor dependency and per-token costs; open-source models (BGE, E5) offer free inference but require GPU infrastructure. Domain-specific factors matter enormously: multilingual corpora need multilingual models (BGE-M3, multilingual-e5), code search needs code-specific embeddings (Code Search Net fine-tuned), and legal text may benefit from domain-adapted models. The MTEB leaderboard (https://huggingface.co/spaces/mteb/leaderboard) is the authoritative ranking, but always validate on your specific domain data.

sections.title: ② Key Code
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Rule-based embedding model recommender.
- 2026 embedding model registry
- Latency requirement (API only)
- Budget constraint (API models)
- Estimate monthly embedding cost for new documents
- Sort by MTEB score
- Usage with different providers

**Defines:** `EmbeddingModelConfig`, `recommend_embedding_model()`, `create_embedder()`

```python
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

@dataclass
class EmbeddingModelConfig:
    name: str
    dimensions: int
    max_tokens: int
    mteb_retrieval_score: float
    cost_per_1m_tokens: float  # 0 for local models
    requires_gpu: bool
    multilingual: bool
    supports_instructions: bool
    latency_ms_api: int

# 2026 embedding model registry
EMBEDDING_MODELS = {
    "openai-3-large": EmbeddingModelConfig(
        name="text-embedding-3-large",
        dimensions=3072,
        max_tokens=8191,
        mteb_retrieval_score=56.9,
        cost_per_1m_tokens=0.13,
        requires_gpu=False,
        multilingual=True,
        supports_instructions=False,
        latency_ms_api=50
    ),
    "openai-3-small": EmbeddingModelConfig(
        name="text-embedding-3-small",
        dimensions=1536,
        max_tokens=8191,
        mteb_retrieval_score=51.7,
        cost_per_1m_tokens=0.02,
        requires_gpu=False,
        multilingual=True,
        supports_instructions=False,
        latency_ms_api=30
    ),
    "cohere-embed-v4": EmbeddingModelConfig(
        name="embed-english-v4.0",
        dimensions=1024,
        max_tokens=512,
        mteb_retrieval_score=55.0,
        cost_per_1m_tokens=0.10,
        requires_gpu=False,
        multilingual=False,
        supports_instructions=True,  # input_type parameter
        latency_ms_api=40
    ),
    "bge-large": EmbeddingModelConfig(
        name="BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5",
        dimensions=1024,
        max_tokens=512,
        mteb_retrieval_score=54.3,
        cost_per_1m_tokens=0.0,
        requires_gpu=True,
        multilingual=False,
        supports_instructions=True,
        latency_ms_api=0  # local
    ),
    "bge-m3": EmbeddingModelConfig(
        name="BAAI/bge-m3",
        dimensions=1024,
        max_tokens=8192,
        mteb_retrieval_score=52.1,
        cost_per_1m_tokens=0.0,
        requires_gpu=True,
        multilingual=True,
        supports_instructions=False,
        latency_ms_api=0
    ),
}

def recommend_embedding_model(
    corpus_size_docs: int,
    daily_queries: int,
    multilingual: bool,
    budget_usd_month: float,
    latency_requirement_ms: int = 200,
) -> EmbeddingModelConfig:
    """Rule-based embedding model recommender."""
    
    # Filter by requirements
    candidates = []
    for key, config in EMBEDDING_MODELS.items():
        # Multilingual requirement
        if multilingual and not config.multilingual:
            continue
        
        # Latency requirement (API only)
        if config.cost_per_1m_tokens > 0 and config.latency_ms_api > latency_requirement_ms:
            continue
        
        # Budget constraint (API models)
        if config.cost_per_1m_tokens > 0:
            # Estimate monthly embedding cost for new documents
            avg_tokens_per_doc = 500
            monthly_index_tokens = corpus_size_docs * avg_tokens_per_doc / 1_000_000
            query_tokens = daily_queries * 30 * 50 / 1_000_000  # 50 tokens/query
            monthly_cost = (monthly_index_tokens + query_tokens) * config.cost_per_1m_tokens
            
            if monthly_cost > budget_usd_month:
                continue
        
        candidates.append((key, config))
    
    if not candidates:
        return EMBEDDING_MODELS["bge-large"]  # Always available (free, local)
    
    # Sort by MTEB score
    best = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1].mteb_retrieval_score)
    return best[1]

# Usage with different providers
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_cohere import CohereEmbeddings

def create_embedder(model_key: str):
    config = EMBEDDING_MODELS[model_key]
    
    if "openai" in model_key:
        return OpenAIEmbeddings(
            model=config.name,
            dimensions=config.dimensions
        )
    elif "cohere" in model_key:
        return CohereEmbeddings(
            model=config.name,
            cohere_api_key="your-api-key"
        )
    else:
        from langchain_huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbeddings
        return HuggingFaceEmbeddings(
            model_name=config.name,
            model_kwargs={"device": "cuda"},
            encode_kwargs={"normalize_embeddings": True}
        )
```
